text.text_excerpt: Rouse's on Chop is my go-to market. I appreciate their vast selection and quality of produce, seafood, meat, and bakery items. They seem to carry most of the brands and items I am looking for most of the time. The staff is very friendly and willing to help out with a question. I am excited to see what the new wine bar will be like when they open it later this year. It seems strange to have a wine bar in a grocery store, but I think it could really work in this location. The prices are slightly higher than what I would have paid at my usual grocery store in Virginia, but I feel that the quality is also slightly higher. I enjoy the cleanliness and overall layout of this store, which is much...

I'd say I do about 80% of my grocery shopping at this Rouses location. Their vegetable selection is unfortunately limited. It is my sincere wish to see this and the fruit sections grow to include more seasonal offerings and rival their liquor display/offerings. But there is always an awesome sale on a vegetable. Also there is plenty of salads. A plus! Their bulk section is half empty. Free coffee samples. Open until midnight. Rouses brand sliced Country Loaf found in the bakery/cake section is truly a rare find. Honestly taste just like homemade bread! Plenty of organic, vegetarian, vegan and health conscious brands available (vegan marshmallows anyone?) Meats are well stocked. Various go...

I live in the LGD and this Rouses is my favorite for grocery shopping for a number of reasons. The location is very convenient to me either by car or the #10 bus line. The parking lot is spacious and most people actually put their carts away so you're not having to dodge carts in parking spaces. The selection in all departments is great and their staff is super helpful if you are looking for something and look lost. There a lot of local products and their deli and meat departments are top notch. (They make their own boudin and sausage and it is high quality and delicious!)
